title: Integrated Survivable Private 5G system with Local Edge, Hybrid Cloud, and SATCOM Connectivity
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.418TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FDO FT HOOD
detail_text: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY. The purpose of this notice is to notify industry of potential upcoming requirements at Fort Hood, TX. Place of Performance: Fort Hood, Texas 76544 Period of Performance: Subject to Change Description of service The Government requires the leasing of equipment that meet the salient characteristics (please see attachment) for a period of 90 days to determine network interoperability and drive future decision points for requirements. The USG intends to 100% set-aside this acquisition for a small business concern. All questions must be submitted no later than 2:00 PM Central Time (UTC-5) on May 1, 2026 , to both the Contract Specialist and the Contract Officer at the above email addresses. Answers to questions will be provided NLT 2:00 PM Central Time (UTC-5) on May 3, 2026. Questions will only be answered via email. Your points of contact regarding this requirement are as follows: Contract Specialist: joshua.s.eash.mil@army.mil Contracting Officer: tyler.d.tamberelli.mil@army.mil Please begin subject line on email with "Pre-solicitation Notice Response Integrated Survivable Private 5G system with Local Edge, Hybrid Cloud, and SATCOM Connectivity" Please see all attachments.
